review.Revert: Button verbs: Revert 'Geri döndür', Put back 'Geri koy', Switch back 'Eskisine geç', Change back 'Geri değiştir', Move back 'Geri taşı', Rotate back 'Geri çevir', Undo 'Geri al'. They must stay distinct; check naturalness.
review.Remove copy: English says copy; glossary Instance = Eş kopya, but for the user-facing button used plain 'Kopyayı kaldır'.
review.Delete plate {n}: '{n}. plakayı sil' (ordinal form); check, since 'Plaka {n}' elsewhere is the name form.
review.Connect your AI app: 'Yapay zeka uygulamanızı bağlayın' - formal 'siz' form as the OrcaSlicer catalogue.
review.changed by you: 'sizin tarafınızdan değiştirildi' is long for a faint note; check if a shorter form fits.
review.Preset: Glossary: 'Ön ayar' (catalogue UI uses 'Ön Ayar' capitalised); used the glossary casing.
review.{n} objects: Same as singular (Turkish has no plural after a number).
review.your app: 'yapay zeka' (no suffix) so '{app} uygulamasını' / '{app} bekleniyor' read passably; imperfect.
review.Settings › Plugins › Add › Add MCP serve: ChatGPT desktop route (orcaslicer-mcp OrcaCloud comment, 2026-11-13): the menu path and the box names are the ChatGPT desktop app's own words in this language (its locale files, app 26.1103), so they match what the user sees there.
